step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows an automated setup for virtual software training using AWS. Instructors trigger CloudFormation templates to provision backend resources (RDS, FSx) and custom image creation via Lambda and Systems Manager. SSM executes scripts on an EC2 instance to configure the AppStream image builder, modifying session scripts to auto-mount FSx storage. Once completed, EC2 signals CloudFormation to finalize AppStream deployment. Students access the Kingdom application running in AppStream via a streaming URL.
